node.statement: The exact antecedent of lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality is the existence of two data (delta_j,S_j,u_j,h_j), j=1,2, for which the explicitly typed maps Pi_{delta_j}:calU x B_{delta_j}^{calH}(J)->S_j, (U,H)|->U bold-dot H, are bijective with inverses (u_j,h_j). Node 1.7.4 supplies this antecedent only for (delta,S_delta,u_pol,h_pol). The contract of lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws supplies u_grp and G(u_grp), but no delta_grp, S_grp, h_grp, typed source/target, formula, or bijectivity/inverse identities connecting u_grp to that Pi. Thus there is no second datum with which to instantiate coherence; the claimed application in 1.7.7 is invalid.
